countries.reasoning: China is the dominant global producer of gallium arsenide due to its substantial rare metal refining and semiconductor industry. Data from recent USGS and industry reports (2021-2023) support this high concentration, but exact figures vary slightly due to proprietary production details.

Russia has significant production capacity from mining and refining activities of gallium-containing ores. Production estimates come from national mineral reports and secondary industry data, but less detailed reporting lowers confidence slightly.

Germany is a key producer within Europe linked to advanced materials production. European Union industry data and scientific sources provide relatively good insight with some margin due to processing complexity.
The US has modest but stable gallium arsenide production focused on high-tech materials. USGS and industry surveys offer reliable data though overall volumes are smaller.

Japan is recognized as a significant producer especially in semiconductor material manufacture. Production data from Japanese government and industrial associations is good but often combined with other gallium compounds, requiring estimation.
